main_text.p: cum certum sit distributionem designari. Tandem hoc obiter annotandum, quod architecti in gradibus observare solent (ut Philander in Vitruvium observavit) ut si pluribus gradibus conscendendum sit, retractio subinde fiat amplior & veluti areola, ubi (ut subdit) fessi respirare & quiescere possint: hoc inquam in hisce gradibus non fuisse neglectum, sed accuratius quam in aliis ædificiis observatum. In illis enim post septimum vel nonum gradum areola requiritur; hic vero tertio loco recurrebat.

פתחו של אולם גובהו ארבעים אמה ורחבו כ׳ אמת וחמש מלחראות של מילה היו על גביו החחחונה עורפח על הפתח אמה מזה ואמה מזה ושל מעלה ממנה עורפח עליה אמה מזה ואמה מזה נמצאת העליונה שלשים אמה ונרבך של אבנים היה בין כל אחת ואחרת :

p.i: ¹ Ostium propylæi erat altitudine 40 cubitorum, ejusque latitudo erat 20 cubitorum. ² Et quinque euerganea trabes è ligno ³ galla, i. robore erant in ejus summitate: infima redundabat super portam cubito hinc & inde, & hæc superior redundabat ⁴ super ipsam cubito hinc & inde: deprehendebatur, supremam esse 30 cubitorum. ⁵ seriesque sive corium lapidum erat inter singulas.

main_text.head: ANNOTATIONES
main_text.p: Devenimus tandem ad primam templi partem, quam porticum vocant: sed quia alio significatu hæc vox in superioribus etiam usurpata fuit, (quamvis & in hac significatione aliquando cum de gradibus &c. ageretur) distinctionis gratia propylæum dicere possumus: Græci προνάου vocant; & ex Valla qui alicubi Latine reddidit [?] protemplaris Minervæ, protemplare fanum dici posset. page.notes: Hebrew block: words in the fourth line (החחחונה), the abbreviation כ׳ in line two, and the top-left line are uncertain and should be checked against the scan. Greek words in the Annotationes: προνάου is probable; the Greek after "Valla qui alicubi Latine reddidit" is printed in italic Greek and is not fully legible, so it is marked [?]. The reference mark {1} before "In altitudine" is a small superscript in the body text; no matching marginal note is printed on this page. Verse numbers 1–5 in the right column are printed as superscripts and are kept as they stand. Long s is normalised to s throughout. No catchword, signature or footnote is visible.
